feedback: Test case R006-T02 is flawed because it incorrectly applies left-to-right evaluation to addition and multiplication, which violates standard arithmetic precedence. Multiplication has higher precedence than addition, so 10 + 5 * 2 + 3 must be evaluated as 10 + (5 * 2) + 3 = 23, not as ((10 + 5) * 2) + 3 = 33. The requirement states that operators of equal precedence are evaluated left to right, but addition and multiplication are not of equal precedence. Therefore, this test case misrepresents the requirement and creates a false expectation. The test should either be removed or corrected to reflect only operators of equal precedence (e.g., addition and subtraction). The current test design fails to accurately reflect the actual mathematical precedence rules and thus does not properly validate the stated requirement. Test cases R006-T01 and R006-T03 are valid and correctly demonstrate left-to-right evaluation for operators of equal precedence (subtraction and addition/subtraction). OnlyR
